alt: Lymphatic system, whole-body view (Blausen). All major lymph node groups labeled - cervical, axillary, mediastinal, mammary, lumbar, pelvic, inguinal. Plus the thoracic duct, cisterna chyli, thymus, spleen, and lymphatics of upper + lower limbs.
